contamination_mechanism: Within each selected held-out pair, replace the second/control-side binary decision with the first/witness-side decision for exactly floor(rate*m) pairs selected by a fixed seed. This models witness examples leaking into the control side and can only set selected paired differences to zero.
decision_rule: Reject when absolute paired mean decision difference is strictly greater than sqrt(2*log(2/alpha)/m).
independence_policy: The 15 model/shard endpoints are independent units. Subsamples remain clustered by model and shard.
